(4) section 32A (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-173..193) -- HPAC-PAWA-AGENT-EXCLUSION/1.0 at <HPAC_PROTECTED_ROOT>/.authority/agent-exclusion.json: a load-bearing protected recognition input, one canonical record per installation, a SIBLING of deployment-owner.json (the HPAC-PAWA-AUTHORITY-DESCRIPTOR/1.0 schema is BYTE-UNCHANGED -- its configured_agent_exclusion_binding still records only kind + basis; HPAC-PAWA-REQ-037 preserved). Closed schema (section 32A.1): artifact_schema_version (const), record_digest (self-excluding SHA-256, HPAC-REQ-089 canonicalisation), symbolic_account (OS account NAME, grammar ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$, not a uid integer / display name / path), provisioned_uid (non-negative integer -- an account-instance continuity pin, NOT the authority basis), installation_id (== the descriptor's and the current-generation record's), protected_root_identity ({device,inode} == live root + manifest), authority_namespace (const .authority), generation (int >= 1), created_at (RFC3339 UTC trusted clock), supersedes (null for first generation else {previous_generation, previous_record_digest}), provenance_ref (HPAC-WRITER-PROVENANCE/1.0 key), state (closed {ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, REVOKED}). No group snapshot as authority (section 32A.6, PAWA-INV-12); no free-form authorized string / operator name / civil identity / is_admin / capability field. Validation (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-177) checks the exact closed field set, digest, symbolic_account grammar, provisioned_uid type, installation_id grammar + equality, {device,inode} equality, generation, created_at, supersedes shape + monotonicity, provenance_ref resolution, state == ACTIVE, and record_digest == current-generation.agent_exclusion_digest; any failure -> agent_principal_unknown, no PRODUCTION writer. symbolic_account (section 32A.2): established only by out-of-band protected administration; not caller / environment / repository controlled; not derived implicitly from the current euid / shell username / agent-lock label. The logical PCAE agent_id string does not inherently map to an OS account -- the semantic bridge is logical configured agent principal -> protected provisioned symbolic_account -> provisioned_uid continuity pin -> live (uid, gids) authority resolution (section 32A.2). provisioned_uid (section 32A.3, C-1): an account-instance continuity check -- detects deletion + recreation under a new uid; NOT sufficient by itself; authority basis remains live effective filesystem write access. Live account resolution (section 32A.4): at EVERY section 33 recognition, resolve symbolic_account from the trusted OS account database and require the lookup succeeds AND live uid == provisioned_uid, else fail closed (agent_principal_unknown); no result cached across production_writer(...) calls. Account deletion (section 32A.5 / HPAC-PAWA-REQ-183): symbolic_account absent -> agent_principal_unknown -> deny; NO fallback to provisioned_uid alone. Recreation under a different uid (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-184): live uid != provisioned_uid -> reject -> deliberate protected reprovision / rotation; NO automatic acceptance of the new principal instance (the R1-PURE silent-rebind path C-1 closes). UID reuse (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-185): name lookup mandatory; NO reverse-uid fallback. Rename (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-186): old name unresolvable -> reject; NO silent follow of the old uid. Live group resolution (section 32A.6, C-1): the account's CURRENT primary AND supplementary groups enumerated LIVE at every recognition and fed as the gids set to _effective_write_access / _ancestor_chain_safe; group membership NEVER persisted as authoritative current state (PAWA-INV-12); the contract freezes the security property, not one OS API (os.getgrouplist on Linux, a grp scan on macOS). Group drift (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-188, DECISIVE): agent added post-provisioning to a group granting write over the protected root or a safe ancestor -> the next recognition enumerates current groups -> _effective_write_access returns True -> agent_has_protected_write_authority -> fail closed. Group removal (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-189): reflected live; the deployment MAY become eligible again with NO reprovision -- a reduction in the agent's authority strictly strengthens the exclusion property. OS account database TCB (section 32A.7 / HPAC-PAWA-REQ-190): pwd / grp / NSS or the platform equivalent is INSIDE PAWA's OS trusted computing base exactly as the OS filesystem protection model is (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-018, PAWA-INV-6); v1.1 SHALL NOT claim resistance to a hostile root / account administrator altering the account database. No environment / caller / current-euid authority (section 32A.8, HPAC-PAWA-REQ-191..193): PCAE_AGENT_PRINCIPAL / USER / LOGNAME / SUDO_USER / SUDO_UID or any similar env var SHALL NOT be the trust source and SHALL NOT override the record; future production APIs SHALL NOT accept configured_agent_uid / gids / symbolic_account or a group set as caller inputs; os.geteuid() / os.getgroups() are NOT the ConfiguredAgentAuthorityIdentity and SHALL NOT substitute for it in section 33 step 3 (they remain the subject of the section 28 positive write probe and one operand of the section 31 comparison -- the three F-1 predicates stay distinct). (5) section 32B (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-194..198) -- provisioning creates the record create-only alongside deployment-owner.json at the descriptor's generation (resolve the admin-selected symbolic_account from the OS account database; capture provisioned_uid; write the record with the current installation_id / {device,inode} / generation; emit its HPAC-WRITER-PROVENANCE/1.0 record; write agent_exclusion_digest into current-generation.json); requires NO HPACWriterCapability, NO FIDO2, NO enrolled principal -- a filesystem provisioning act plus an OS-account-DB read, NON-CIRCULAR (PAWA-INV-4). Account selection (section 32B.2): symbolic_account SHALL be an explicit protected-administration input (a --agent-account <name> argument to scripts/hpac_protected_root_admin.py provision / set-agent-exclusion); never implicit from the current euid / shell username / env var alone / agent-lock label alone. Duplicate bootstrap (section 32B.3): a second provision against a live valid installation SHALL NOT silently overwrite the record -- fail closed (duplicate_bootstrap) or explicitly enter rotation; an idempotent no-op only when byte-identical. Rotation / reprovision (section 32B.4): changing the configured agent OS account is an explicit deployment-owner action -- new record at generation = old + 1 with supersedes = {previous_generation, previous_record_digest}; emit provenance; atomically replace current-generation.json with the new agent_exclusion_digest and current_generation = old + 1; mark the old record SUPERSEDED (or remove it); after rotation the old record no longer satisfies section 33 (its digest no longer matches the anchor). Machine migration (section 32B.5): fresh installation_id + {device,inode} on the new host -> the record is re-provisioned deliberately; a copied agent-exclusion.json alone carries a non-matching installation_id / {device,inode} -> agent_principal_unknown; it never validates (PAWA-INV-5, PAWA-INV-12).
